snippet.title: Bubumbu | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Bubumbu is a short and wholesome puzzle game in which you get to help lost objects find their way back to where they belong, while exploring fully hand-drawn worlds full of quirky characters!
